text:
dina: Quick brain-dump: propose a 'postmortem follow-up lite' that forces an owner + fallback + 60/90/120 TTL presets. Goal: reduce stale actions and speed handoffs.

hiro: Love the presets. Keep the UI tiny. Fields: rem-id, owner, fallback, ttl, due-date, reminders, status.

sam: Can we add a small flag 'repeat-mode' for incidents that look familiar? If set, the tracker should surface similar past incidents during assignment.

leah: About IC rotation: instead of adding weekend rotations, offer a quarterly 'soft-standby' person who gets a calendar block and only gets paged after the oncall does primary checks. Avoids extra oncall churn.

dina: Pilot plan: roll to infra + platform for 5 weeks. Metrics: % overdue, median ack time, repeat-mode hits. I'll own the pilot.

incident-bot: Created pilot watcher 'pm-lite-ownership'. Automation: DM owner at TTL-7d and TTL-1d, post weekly digest to #eng-oncall. To enable full payload, PM add Confluence template link. :robot_face:

hiro: I'll be fallback for the pilot week. Happy to help wire the ack timestamp event.

dina: Action items: dina - add Confluence template & tracker fields; incident-bot - enable pings after template URL; sam - prototype repeat-mode matcher; leah - draft soft-standby calendar + rotation notes. Reconvene next Tue in #eng-oncall to confirm kickoff. :eyes:
